title: Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Greek Yogurt Dressing

steps: Add 3/4 - 1 cup Greek yogurt, 1-2 tbsp mayo, 1-2 tsp Dijon, 4-5 anchovies, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, juice from 1/2 - 1 lemon, 1/2 tsp garlic salt, 1/4 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper into a blender, then blend until smooth and creamy and set aside.
Line up 3 bowls: in bowl 1, combine 1/2 cup flour, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper; in bowl 2, place 1-2 beaten eggs; in bowl 3, combine about 1 cup panko crumbs and 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat, and coat each piece of chicken in the flour, then egg wash, then breadcrumbs to coat completely.
Place chicken on the hot pan for 3-4 minutes each side, using a meat thermometer to check when it is done (reaching 165°F), then serve with the blended dressing and enjoy!

title: Lemon Dijon Baked Chicken Thighs and Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 cup lemon olive oil from O Olive Oil
1-3 tsp honey apple vinegar from O Olive Oil

steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Add the lemon olive oil, Dijon mustard, honey apple vinegar, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to a jar and shake well until combined.
Halve then quarter the yellow potatoes, place them in the bottom of a baking dish, and place the chicken thighs on top.
Pour the prepared marinade evenly over the chicken and potatoes.
Cover the baking dish with tin foil or a lid and bake in the oven at 425°F for 45 minutes, then remove the cover and broil for an additional 5 minutes so the chicken can get nice and crispy.

cards.title: Marinade
cards.text: Add the lemon olive oil, Dijon mustard, honey apple vinegar, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to a jar and shake well until combined.

1-3 tsp honey apple vinegar from O Olive Oil

cards.text: Cover the baking dish with tin foil or a lid and bake in the oven at 425°F for 45 minutes.

title: Cinnamon Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup warm milk (microwave for 90 seconds and then test)

steps: Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Place milk in a microwave-safe bowl and microwave for about 90 seconds until warmed, then stir in yeast and 2 tablespoons of sugar (scooped from the 1/2 cup) and let proof for 5-10 minutes.

In a large mixing bowl, combine the remaining sugar, eggs, 6 tablespoons of melted butter, and salt. Add the activated yeast mixture, then stir in flour, 3 cups at a time, watching for the dough to start coming off the sides of the bowl.
Turn off the preheated 200-degree oven. Place dough in an oven-safe bowl, cover with a moist towel, and place in the oven to rise for 1 hour to double in size.

Roll the doubled dough out on a floured surface into a large rectangle. Spread 1/4 cup softened butter over dough, mix brown sugar and cinnamon in a bowl, sprinkle over the dough, then tightly roll up dough and slice into rolls.

Place rolls on greased baking sheets, cover loosely with a towel or Saran Wrap, and let rise for at least 1 hour, preheating the oven to 400 degrees toward the end of the rise, then bake at 400 degrees for 9-12 minutes.
To make frosting, cream together 1/2 cup softened butter and cream cheese for 2 minutes, then stir in powdered sugar and vanilla. Spread over slightly cooled cinnamon rolls and serve warm.

cards.title: Dough: Proof the Yeast
cards.text: Preheat oven to 200 degrees. Place milk in a microwave-safe bowl and microwave for about 90 seconds until warmed, then stir in yeast and 2 tablespoons of sugar (scooped from the 1/2 cup) and let proof for 5-10 minutes.
uses: 1 cup warm milk (microwave for 90 seconds and then test)

cards.title: Dough: Mix
cards.text: In a large mixing bowl, combine the remaining sugar, eggs, 6 tablespoons of melted butter, and salt. Add the activated yeast mixture, then stir in flour, 3 cups at a time, watching for the dough to start coming off the sides of the bowl.

cards.title: Dough: Rise
cards.text: Turn off the preheated 200-degree oven. Place dough in an oven-safe bowl, cover with a moist towel, and place in the oven to rise for 1 hour to double in size.

cards.title: Filling: Roll & Slice
cards.text: Roll the doubled dough out on a floured surface into a large rectangle. Spread 1/4 cup softened butter over dough, mix brown sugar and cinnamon in a bowl, sprinkle over the dough, then tightly roll up dough and slice into rolls.

cards.title: Rolls: Second Rise
cards.text: Place rolls on greased baking sheets, cover loosely with a towel or Saran Wrap, and let rise for at least 1 hour.
cards.while: While the rolls rise, heat the oven to 400 degrees and make the frosting (step 7).

cards.title: Frosting: Make & Spread
cards.text: To make frosting, cream together 1/2 cup softened butter and cream cheese for 2 minutes, then stir in powdered sugar and vanilla. Spread over slightly cooled cinnamon rolls and serve warm.
